scope: Focused candidate audit for missing original-body hardware. Public official Sketchfab search and per-model metadata; creator publisher thumbnails inspected at native size. No authenticated files downloaded, no viewer extraction, no runtime edits. Recommendations require root/user choice and real file verification.

candidates.title: NES Console and Controller
candidates.creator: Daz
candidates.license_requirements: Author must be credited. Commercial use is allowed.
candidates.represented_variant: Grey front-loading western NES with matching controller
candidates.visual_assessment: Readable labels, controller details, rear/side ports, venting and restrained surface wear visible in publisher preview.
candidates.caveat: Source description says 1986 broadly; retain region-specific 1985 North American and 1986 European chronology, not a worldwide date.
candidates.bundling: If selected, root obtains the official licensed source download, bundles the resulting asset with app, and records exact file hash and licence. Source page is not an importable asset URL.

missing.excluded_sources_reason: The exact original-object sources remain view-only without a demonstrated reuse grant. Previous official Objaverse and S3D3C checks did not establish a licensed archive.

wrong_variant_found.creator: Instituto Bojog?
wrong_variant_found.reason: Later integrated Odyssey 200-style console, with six controls and switches in one body; not the original 1972 modular Odyssey. Must not substitute silently.

quality_note: No candidate is marked downloaded or native-verified. Texture count is publisher metadata, not a promise of embedded texture quality. High triangle count is not used as a proxy for historical accuracy.
rights_note: Preserve exact licences, creator credits, revision captions and third-party notices. Assets remain individually licensed and bundled; no promise that a viewer URL can be used as a direct asset.
